The company operates its verified website at https://exigovvs.no/.
It operates publicly under the brand name 'Exigo VVS', according to its website.

Net result was 787,458 NOK, with total assets of 5,252,861 NOK and equity of 743,327 NOK.

Operating margin was 10.5% (derived: operating result / revenue).

Daily operations are led by general manager Geir Vingelsgaard.

No corporate group hierarchy or parent company is registered.
